choice: Retain source logical identity and exact bytes separately from repository physical placement. An expansion advertises its explicit layout policy; exact reconstruction requires the complete finite actual output path set and bytes, plus inverse recovery of the full logical set, not selected-byte spot checks.
logical_identity: A retained revision identifies exact source occurrences, catalog bytes and context bytes. Relocation does not rewrite its identities, historical hashes, source status or immutable parent chain.
decision_rules: Reject actual finite placement collisions before accepting the expansion. Compare the entire actual mapped path set and raw bytes independently, including missing and extra paths. Invert the declared finite mapping and compare the complete logical set and bytes.

Qualify trace consumers by an exact retained revision; a successful retained-revision read does not establish live-current freshness. Preserve stale-current rejection separately from explicit historical-revision success.
Source, catalog, context, HEAD or verifier drift creates a new observation and, when needed, a separate replay receipt. Never refresh an old receipt hash or source path to imply replay.
A compare-and-swap failure preserves the attempted manifest, objects and failure receipt. It cannot advance current. A successful later attempt has its own immutable identity and parent.
